title: Question 1 Comprehension: Model Answers
page_title: Question 1 Model Answers - CIE IGCSE English Language

blocks.md: **This revision note is for exams in 2026. If you are sitting your exam from 2027, please switch to the 'First exams 2027' syllabus edition.**

Question 1 is split into two tasks: a comprehension task and a summary task. The comprehension task will be based on Text A in your reading insert, and is designed as a series of short-answer questions, testing your ability to select and interpret what you read appropriately.

The following is Text A taken from the June 2022 exam paper and is about *endurance* running events. Question 1(a-e) will ask you either to identify specific information from this text, or explain something from the text in your own words.

blocks.alt: Text discussing the rise of endurance events like marathons and triathlons, and their transformation from niche activities to popular challenges for many.

blocks.md: Below you will find the questions based on the above text, along with suggested answers:

blocks.alt: Text explains endurance events like triathlons and adventure races. A question asks for examples, not including ultra-marathons. A clue suggests answers.
Text discussing endurance events like triathlons, describing them as challenging competitors' limits. Annotations explain "challenge the limits.".
Text with explanation defines "mythical beast" as imaginary; context discusses marathon runners as once rare, now common and ordinary.
Text box explaining that Tough Mudder is an extreme short race involving hazards like electric shocks and fire, differing from endurance events.
Text details reasons a writer motivated by physical dissatisfaction and lifestyle became obsessed with extreme sports, seeking adrenaline and engagement.
Text discusses the rise of extreme sports due to sterile life and lack of excitement, with a question asking for three reasons for their popularity growth.
Text compares Ironman events to marathons, highlighting the quieter achievement of marathons. Exam question asks why Ironman athletes might prefer marathons.

blocks.md:
- Remember to read each sub-question carefully and highlight:

  - What you have to do (“give two examples”/”write your answer in your own words”, etc.)
  - What you have to look for in the text (the focus of the question)
- Pay attention to the number of marks awarded for each sub-question and write your answers accordingly
- Make sure you are reading the correct section of text (according to the sub-question instructions)
- If the question asks you to use your own words,*most* of your answer needs to be in your own words; you must not just copy and paste from the text
- These are short-answer questions so do not waste time writing paragraphs when short sentences will do:

  - Writing more will not get you more marks - the examiner can only award the amount of marks allocated to each sub-question
The full June 2022 exam paper is available [here](https://www.savemyexams.com/igcse/english-language/cie/past-papers/).
